name: cafeos
description: CafeOS — PWA-based Online Ordering App System for a Cafe

scripts.demo:local: npm run db:start && npm run db:seed-auth && npm run build:start:local
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/customer && npm run build -w apps/pos && npm run build -w apps/admin
scripts.build:start: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.build:start:customer: npm run build -w apps/customer && npm run start -w apps/customer
scripts.build:start:pos: npm run build -w apps/pos && npm run start -w apps/pos
scripts.build:start:admin: npm run build -w apps/admin && npm run start -w apps/admin
scripts.db:seed-dummy: supabase migration up && tsx scripts/apply-local-sql.ts supabase/seed_dummy_operational.sql
scripts.db:reset: supabase db reset && npm run db:seed-auth
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/customer/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/pos/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/admin/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
